findings.evidence: Target labels Signal_A through Signal_H and S01 through S09 replace reference labels. Heatmap colors and marginal bar shapes differ, while the 8 by 9 structure and aligned layers are preserved.

findings.evidence: The rendered panel visibly has 72 cell positions and three gray cells. Pixel inspection cannot establish every source value, a measured zero, or measured-only mean arithmetic. Those checks were deliberately outside this review.

findings.action: Use the separate source-to-export audit for numeric readiness; do not interpret this visual status as a numeric sign-off.

visual_checks.evidence: Eight labeled rows and nine labeled columns; no missing or clipped label, visible 8 by 9 rectangular array.
Three colored strip blocks align with columns S01-S03, S04-S06, S07-S09. Guide colors match the strip and remain subordinate to the main data region.
All eight horizontal bars share the heatmap row centers. Mean score axis and zero line are legible; near-zero rows remain near the origin.
Blue-to-red horizontal scale labels -2, 0 and 2, with neutral center. Three gray cells are visibly different from neutral score cells and have a matching Unmeasured key.
Relative geometry, strip position, borderless cells and bars, rotated specimen labels, horizontal scale, compact top guide and lower-right unmeasured key follow the reference.

PDF rendered at 96 dpi provides approximately 454 by 341 screen pixels for the 120 by 90 mm page; all labels and keys remain legible with no overlap or clipping. This is a proportion check rather than a calibrated physical print.
Only data-reading text appears in the panel. Separate caption supplies synthetic-data context, score semantics, missingness and measured-only descriptive-mean method without invented panel numbering.
